description: Opt-in for uv repos, on top of default. Consumed as local>bluesky-social/.github//renovate/uv#v1. Only for repos where uv enforces the cooldown: [tool.uv] exclude-newer = "3 days" and required-version = ">=0.9.17" in pyproject.toml (older uv silently ignores durations). Direct minors stay manual: uv still runs build backends for sdist-only packages.

packageRules.description: Renovate's security PRs only bump declared dependencies; transitive fixes land through the weekly uv.lock refresh. fix: so it releases.
